Junior Python Developer Trainee

Only for Keralites

Company: Arcraft Infotech
Location: Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: Freshers / 01 Year
Department: Software Development
Role Type: Project Experience

About the Role

Arcraft Infotech is looking for ambitious tech enthusiasts and graduates to join our Python Developer & Placement Program.

This is a structured career-launch program designed for aspiring developers. You will undergo an intensive, hands-on skill development phase led by industry experts, followed by direct placement assistance and interviews with our network of tech hiring partners. If you are eager to build a career in software development but need the right practical stack and corporate bridge to get hired, this is your starting point.

Key Responsibilities

Participate actively in the company's structured Python development program.Learn and apply Python programming concepts through practical exercises.Develop coding skills through assignments and problem-solving activities.Work on individual and team-based Own & Clients Python projects.Understand project requirements and translate them into technical solutions.Write clean, readable, and maintainable Python code.Debug programs and troubleshoot technical issues.Work with databases and perform basic database operations.Maintain proper documentation of assigned projects and tasks.Take feedback from mentors and continuously improve technical skills.Collaborate with team members during project development.Follow company coding standards, development practices, and project guidelines.Project Exposure

During the period, trainees will be given opportunities to work on practical projects that help them understand the complete development process, including:

Requirement understandingPlanning and task allocationCoding and implementationDatabase integrationTesting and debuggingVersion controlDocumentationProject presentationThe project assignments will be designed according to the trainee's learning progress and technical capability.

Required Skills

Basic knowledge of Python programming.Understanding of basic programming concepts.Basic knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming is preferred.Logical thinking and problem-solving ability.Basic knowledge of SQL/database concepts is an advantage.Familiarity with Git/GitHub is an added advantage.Good communication and teamwork skills.Strong interest in software development and willingness to learn.Educational Qualification

B.Tech / B.E / BCA / MCA / B.Sc Computer Science / IT or equivalent qualification.Candidates who have completed Python, Python Full Stack, or related technical courses are encouraged to apply.Eligibility

Freshers and candidates with 01 year of experience can apply.Candidates with academic projects or personal Python projects are welcome.Candidates should have a genuine interest in building a career in Python development.Trainee's Evaluation

The trainee's progress will be evaluated throughout the training and project period based on:

Technical learning and improvementCoding abilityAssignment completionProject performanceProblem-solving skillsAttendance and participationAbility to work in a teamProfessional conductOverall performanceBased on Candidate performance, technical capability, and organizational requirements, trainees may be considered for further development opportunities within the organization.

What We Offer

Upon successful completion of the program and project milestone evaluations, you will transition directly into our Placement Support Program:

Direct interview scheduling with partner tech companies and startups.Comprehensive resume building and GitHub profile optimization.Technical mock interviews and aptitude coaching led by hiring managersStructured Python development trainingHands-on project experiencePractical exposure to software developmentMentorship and technical guidanceIndividual and team-based projectsExposure to industry-oriented development practicesOpportunity to build a strong technical portfolioCareer growth opportunities based on performance and organizational requirementsJoin Arcraft Infotech and build your career in Python development through structured training and practical project experience.

Work Location: In person .

jobs_results.title: Python Django Trainer Cum Developer
jobs_results.description:
Python Django Trainer cum Developer – Fresher

Company: IROHUB Infotech Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year

Job Summary

IROHUB Infotech is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic Python Django Trainer cum Developer to join our team. This role is suitable for freshers who have strong fundamentals in Python and a basic understanding of Django and web development.

The candidate will be involved in student training, mentoring, practical project guidance, and software development activities.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct training sessions on Python and Django for students.

- Explain programming concepts through practical examples and coding exercises.

- Guide students in developing projects and applications.

- Assist students with debugging and resolving coding issues.

- Develop and maintain web applications using Python and Django.

- Work on internal and live projects as required.

- Conduct practical assessments and provide technical guidance to students.

- Stay updated with the latest Python, Django, and web development technologies.

- Maintain a professional and engaging learning environment.

Requirements

- Strong knowledge of Python programming.

- Basic knowledge of Django framework.

- Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Basic knowledge of SQL and databases.

- Good problem-solving and debugging skills.

- Good communication and presentation skills.

- Passion for teaching, mentoring, and software development.

- Willingness to learn new technologies.

- Freshers with relevant academic projects or internship experience are encouraged to apply.

Educational Qualification

B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent qualification.

Skills

Python | Django | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | SQL | Web Development | Problem Solving | Communication

What We Offer

- Hands-on experience in training and software development.

- Opportunity to work on practical and live projects.

- Professional learning and career growth opportunities.

- Supportive and collaborative work environment.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs_results.title: Python Developer - Kochi
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Cami.AI is a smart customer success platform that helps customers build and maintain consistent revenue to create scalable customer love. It leverages machine learning to help bridge the gaps between all the stakeholders who touch the customer.


https://www.linkedin.com/company/cami-ai


Learn more about the job at https://www.cami.ai/careers/



Job Description

Your Role:


Cami.AI is looking for a Python engineer who wants to work with significant autonomy on a small, entrepreneurial team. In this role, you will be the expert in integrating Cami.AI systems with various customer systems to exchange data. You will also write machine learning workers on top of the data extracted that will continue to grow the intelligence of the system. You’ll have the opportunity to solve interesting problems to build the customer success platform of the future.


Our Tech Stack :


What you will work on: Python, AWS Sagemaker, AWS Glue, Node JS, Delta Lake, Spark


Other technologies used in the company: Angular 12, HTML5 , CSS3, AWS Amplify, DynamoDB, Elastic Search





What You’ll Do:


Develop reusable integrations, both inbound and outbound, between Cami.AI systems and other customer platforms. Assist in designing, enhancing, and constructing new and existing features using performant, scalable, secure, documented, and maintainable code


Quickly produce well-organized, optimized, well-tested, and documented code


Collaborate with other Engineers and Operations to design and implement features


Communicate effectively and efficiently with teammates and other departments


Meet deadlines and satisfy requirements. Participate in agile ceremonies such as iteration planning, retrospective, and daily stand-ups





What We Offer:


As a Data Integration Engineer, you’ll receive a competitive compensation package. Most importantly you will also participate in the value created in the company over the years and be part of a growing entrepreneurial team.





Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field/experience


2+ years relevant programming experience with an emphasis on data integrating in structured and unstructured formats such as flat-files, JSON, and XML


Strong knowledge of OOP and reusable coding practices


Experience with Python, serverless environments, microservices, and RESTful/SOAP APIs


Experienced using practices such as unit testing, integration testing, proper code documentation, and appropriate logging to develop highly maintainable and reliable code


Basic understanding of scrum, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and DevOps


A working knowledge of SaaS platforms is a plus



Additional Information

Cami.AI is a fast growing SAAS platform that aspires to be the next Unicorn in Kochi. This is the right job if you are looking to make a difference and work with a high performance high energy team.

jobs_results.title: SAP Finance Backend Developer (Kochi)
jobs_results.description:
Description of position 

SAP Finance Backend Developer with expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance modules. Candidate will ensure design and development of systems that meet specifications and requirements of project and overall business needs with little supervision. The SAP S/4HANA Backend Analyst works alongside other developers and functional support analysts, handling multiple tasks simultaneously to create intuitive and efficient solutions.

Together, they must work as peers and be able to collaborate and communicate effectively with extended team members.

Tasks and responsibilities

 Designs business applications with a high attention to quality and details, while following naming and technical standards set by Costco

 Collaborates with analysts, designers, and system owners in the testing of SAP software programs and applications

 Provides SAP support including analysis, development, testing, tracking and resolution

 Demonstrates a logical and structured approach to time management and task prioritization

 Demonstrates a high level of communication skills, verbal and written

 Mentoring less experienced team members on SAP programming concepts and tool suite

 Responsible for continued personal growth in the areas of technology, business knowledge and Costco policies and platforms

 Participates in team activities and team planning in regards to improving team skills, awareness and quality of work

Required skills and abilities

 Minimum 5+ years of experience in SAP (ABAP) development

 Proficiency in ABAP for SAP S/4HANA, including CDS views, AMDP, and RAP/BOPF

 Experience with financial modules like General Ledger (FI-GL), Accounts Payable (FI-AP), Accounts Receivable (FI-AR), and Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

 Understanding of financial reporting and accounting processes

 Experience with S/4HANA backend development, OData services, and integration with SAP BTP or cloud platforms

 Knowledge of modern SAP development standards for S/4HANA and NetWeaver platform

 Experienced in all SAP enhancement techniques (BADIs, User Exits, Enhancement points) within the S/4HANA environment

 Solid conceptual, analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting and resolution skills with an emphasis on Advanced ABAP debugger skills to support quick turnaround of analysis and issue resolution

 Experienced with all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

 Extensive knowledge in handling RICEFW and experience in end to end S/4HANA implementation

 Create and execute unit test scripts to ensure the development objects provide accurate results and meet requirements

 Self-motivated, flexible, eager to learn new things

 Strong focus on customer needs

 Must have the ability to work with limited supervision and exhibit a strong sense of urgency

 Collaborate with analysts, designers, and system owners in the testing of SAP software programs and applications

 Ability to effectively mentor less experienced team members on SAP programming and testing techniques

 One or more full project life cycle SAP implementation including blueprinting, configuration, testing, training and post implementation support

 Plan, schedule and track project timeline, milestones and deliverables, and report status to project stakeholders and/or management on a regular basis

 Good understanding of corporate IT policies, procedures and standards

 Good decision making skills

Recommended skills, abilities, and certifications

 General understanding of finance and merchandise accounting processes

 Experience with financial reporting tools

Experience with Vistex or similar financial integrations .
